title: Require Habitat Authority Packet Topology
forbids: an open legacy compatibility packet, an unqualified blueprint component group, a successor closure misclassified as a compatibility packet, or an executable source outside Habitat's native rule forms
why: Versioned blueprints compose declared rules from one structural anchor and focused Markdown source assets. Complete successor closures live under the reserved versions/<version> locator and are not compatibility packets. Remaining v2 compatibility packets retain their closed rule and baseline envelope until they migrate into that model.
remediate: Keep complete successor definitions and their declared assets under versions/<version>. Keep component source under components/<role>/*.md and register it from blueprint.toml. Keep rule.json and baseline.json only in remaining v2 compatibility packets, alongside their selected pattern.md or structure.toml source.
message: Habitat authority packets must retain one closed native policy surface.
